correctness.rationale: For Petersen P=KG(5,2), adjacency is disjointness of two-subsets, degree 3 and square-free. Independent enumeration of all closed odd walks gives Hom(C5,P) 120 zero-cells, Hom(C7,P) 1680, Hom(C9,P) 17640, agreeing with trace formula 3^m+5+4(-2)^m. Changing one coordinate to a common neighbor gives connected-component distributions 120 singleton at m5; 24 components of size70 at m7; at m9 24 of size720 plus 360 singleton. A separate 50-state compatible-subset transfer enumerator independently reproduces complete CW f-vectors (120), (1680,2520,840), (17640,45360,44280,19440,3240), giving χ0 for each nontrivial component, with isolated maps χ1. Square-free graph-Hom theorem of Matsushita/Fujii–Kimura–Nozaki for nonbipartite source implies every component is contractible or S1, so χ0 components are circles. The S5 ground-set action on all circle components is transitive with stabilizer of order5 (checked by direct permutation enumeration), and a C5 action on integral H1 of a circle has trivial orientation sign, yielding Ind_{C5}^{S5} Z. Twenty nine-cycles ×2 orientations×9 start points give all 360 isolated maps; finite checks here are exhaustive for three stated lengths, not an all-odd theorem.
residual_risks: Finite diagnostics alone cannot prove the universal aspects; the cited arguments supply those steps.
